self.view.custom.notificationLabel = ""
	self.view.custom.provider = ""
	try:
		#Find list of providers
		tags=system.tag.browse(filter={"tagType":"Provider"}).results
		
		providerList = []
		
		#Loop Through each of the providors 
		for result in tags:
		
			dList = {}
			provider = str(result['fullPath'])
			
			dList["value"] = provider
			dList["label"] = provider
			
			#Add to the providor list
			providerList.append(dList)
		
#		self.getChild('Provider Selection').getChild('Gateway Provider Selection').props.options = providerList
		self.view.custom.providerList = providerList
	except:
		self.view.custom.notificationLabel = "Error: Cannot find any tag providers"

changesStaged = self.view.custom.writeTags
	newStageTags = []
	changesMade = self.view.custom.changesMade
	provider = self.view.custom.provider
	udtPath = self.view.custom.selectedUDTType
	
	for eachChange in changesStaged:
		oList = {}
		tagPath = provider+"_types_/"+udtPath+eachChange["label"].replace("{...}","")
		splitName = tagPath.rsplit("/",1)
		
		#first do engUnit
		if eachChange["newEngUnit"] != "":
			newEngUnit = {"name":splitName[1],"engUnit":eachChange["newEngUnit"]}
			resultUnit = system.tag.configure(splitName[0], newEngUnit,"m")
			oList['newEngUnit'] = eachChange['newEngUnit']
		else:
			resultUnit = [""]
		
		#second do formatString
		if eachChange["newFormatString"] != "":
			newformatString = {"name":splitName[1],"formatString":eachChange["newFormatString"]}
			resultFormatString = system.tag.configure(splitName[0], newformatString,"m")
			oList['newFormatString'] = eachChange['newFormatString']
		else:
			resultFormatString = [""]
			
		oList['label'] = tagPath
		oList['engUnit'] = eachChange['engUnit']
		oList['formatString'] = eachChange['formatString']

		oList['resultUnit'] = resultUnit[0]
		oList['resultFormatString'] = resultFormatString[0]
		
		changesMade.append(oList)
		
	self.view.custom.writeReset = 0
	system.perspective.sendMessage('getUDTTags')
	self.view.custom.writeTags = []

	writeTags = self.view.custom.writeTags
	newStageTags = []
	changesStaged = self.view.custom.changesStaged
	
	for eachInstance in allUDTInstances:
		if eachInstance['selected']:
			for eachTag in writeTags:
				oList = {}
				newList = {}
				try:
					splitPath = eachInstance['label'].split("]",1)[1]
				except:
					splitPath = eachInstance['label']
				
				tagPath = provider + str(splitPath) + eachTag['label'].replace('{...}','')
				eachOldValue = system.tag.readBlocking([tagPath])[0]
				eachHistoryValue = system.tag.queryTagHistory([tagPath], system.date.addDays(system.date.now(), -180), system.date.now())
				historyString = ''
				lastHistory = ""
				for row in range(eachHistoryValue.getRowCount()):
					if str(eachHistoryValue.getValueAt(row, 1)) != lastHistory:
						historyString += str(eachHistoryValue.getValueAt(row, 1)) + ', '
					lastHistory = str(eachHistoryValue.getValueAt(row, 1))
				
				
				oList['label'] = tagPath
				oList['oldValue'] = eachOldValue
				oList['newValue'] = eachTag['newValue']
				oList['historyValue'] = eachHistoryValue
				oList['historyValueString'] = str(historyString.strip(', '))
